title: Onboard cynosure-13b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Add cynosure-13b v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata, validated performance profiles, and automated changelog/release note generation. This enables customers to reference performance expectations for hosted/dedicated deployments and keeps release notes in sync with onboarding steps.

Summary of changes: 1) model metadata (schema-compliant YAML + README), 2) performance profile JSONs for common sequence lengths and batch sizes, 3) automated changelog generator integration (commits generate release notes entry via registry CI), 4) lightweight validation harness for perf profile sanity checks, 5) docs and examples.

Checklist:
- [x] Model metadata YAML (name, version, architecture, tokenizer, sample_prompt)
- [x] Performance profiles for 512/1024/2048 seq lengths and 1/4/8 batch sizes
- [x] Changelog automation hook (registry-changelog-bot) wired into model registry CI
- [x] Unit tests for metadata schema and perf profile parser
- [x] Docs updated under /models/cynosure-13b/
- [x] Security review for artifact URLs and checksum verification

Testing and CI: Initial run showed lint failures (yaml formatting) and one flaky perf-check failure on CI node runner-04 (timeout). Fixed by normalizing YAML line endings and increasing perf-check timeout with retry. Final CI (unit/integration/perf-regression) passed on rerun. See CI summary below.

Rollout: Merge to main triggers automated registry index update and a changelog entry created by the registry-changelog-bot. No migration required for existing registry consumers; clients will see cynosure-13b:v1.0 available in model catalog after the index update.

Notes: The perf profiles are conservative and include CPU/GPU memory estimates which feed into provisioning recommendations for Dedicated pools. If future runs reduce latency further, we will publish an updated perf profile patch (minor version bump).

Related: Linear ENG-2021, PM-312. Test artifacts and perf logs are attached to the CI run and stored in the artifacts bucket (s3://redwood-registry-artifacts/cynosure-13b/ci-834562/).

release_notes: Added cynosure-13b v1.0 to model registry with initial performance profiles (512/1024/2048 tokens), metadata, and automated changelog generation. Customers can reference recommended Dedicated pool sizing and memory estimates. See docs/models/cynosure-13b.md for usage and examples.
notes_on_automation: registry-changelog-bot now accepts model onboarding payloads from model-registry CI
changelog payload includes artifact URL + checksum and perf profile summary
CI will auto-create a release-notes draft on main after merge
risk_assessment: low - new model onboarding is read-only for clients and follows existing schema; perf profiles are conservative. Automation creates a draft changelog entry which must be approved by registry maintainers before public release.
rollout_plan: Merge -> registry index update (automatic) -> create draft changelog entry -> manual verification by registry maintainers -> publish catalog update. No client migration required.
notes: Perf logs archived at s3://redwood-registry-artifacts/cynosure-13b/ci-834562/; contact @ava if artifacts need to be re-run with larger batch sizes.
